supersedes: 1.0 (v1.0 assumed a V-shaped ravine, a skybridge return route, and mkr_ravine_bottom; v2.0 drops both and replaces the marker with mkr_service_tunnel_contact_crossing)
description: Build specification for the AI contractor. The Map Integration is the meta-build that connects the existing schematic library and the live bot world to the new 1,500 x 1,500 Combined Complex world. The 4 master plan PDFs (Cheyenne, SubTropolis, Houston, Combined Complex) and the Combined Complex master plan are already complete. This brief is the integration layer that wires them to the existing bot world. v2.0 reflects three upstream design updates: (1) the combined complex mountain is ONE CONTINUOUS mountain with a HORIZONTAL granite-limestone contact at Y=200, not a V-shaped ravine; (2) the return route from Cheyenne is funicular + summit road, no skybridge; (3) the composite terrane plaque is at the service tunnel contact crossing at (-40, 200, -360), not at a ravine bottom. The 6 named markers are mkr_city_center, mkr_public_shaft_top, mkr_subtropolis_chamber_center, mkr_service_tunnel_contact_crossing, mkr_cheyenne_outer_portal, mkr_old_town_center.

design_updates_from_v1_0.mountain_geometry: ONE CONTINUOUS mountain (no ravine). Lower 200 blocks (Y=0 to Y=200) are 270 Ma Bethany Falls limestone. Upper 600 blocks (Y=200 to Y=800) are 1.08 Ga Pikes Peak granite. The contact is HORIZONTAL at Y=200 and is exposed inside the service tunnel at (-40, 200, -360) as a visible rock face.
design_updates_from_v1_0.ravine_dropped: The V-shaped fluvial ravine between the two peaks is removed. The mountain is intact. The stream that previously flowed at the bottom of the ravine is now an above-ground coastal-plain stream crossed by a stone-brick bridge on the Grand Avenue at block 380.
design_updates_from_v1_0.skybridge_dropped: There is NO skybridge return from the Cheyenne chamber. The return route is a funicular rail from the Cheyenne outer portal (0, 200, -420) climbing 600 blocks up to the granite summit (0, 800, -420), then a switchback summit road descending ~1200 blocks back to the city SE corner (60, 0, 70).
design_updates_from_v1_0.terrane_plaque_relocated: The composite terrane plaque is at the service tunnel contact crossing at (-40, 200, -360) — the visible granite-limestone contact face. NOT at a ravine bottom.
design_updates_from_v1_0.marker_replacement: mkr_ravine_bottom is removed. mkr_service_tunnel_contact_crossing is added at (-40, 200, -360). The 6 named markers are now: mkr_city_center, mkr_public_shaft_top, mkr_subtropolis_chamber_center, mkr_service_tunnel_contact_crossing, mkr_cheyenne_outer_portal, mkr_old_town_center.

scale.notes: 1:1 globally per discussion-notes Decision 1. New world requires 1,024+ build height (CubicWorld 2,048 recommended). Existing world is vanilla 384, preserved as-is. The mountain is one continuous mass from Y=0 (city level) to Y=800 (granite peak). 1:1 vertical — no compression.

city.description: 138m x 138m downtown at Y=0 street grade. World origin at center.

coastal_plain.description: Flat grass plain surrounding the city on the south side. Where the old town and the rail spur live.

limestone_hillside.description: Lower 200 blocks of the mountain. 270 Ma Bethany Falls limestone. SubTropolis chamber is carved here, the public shaft descends into it, and the lower service tunnel runs through it.

granite_peak.description: Upper 600 blocks of the mountain. 1.08 Ga Pikes Peak granite. Cheyenne chamber is carved here, the funicular rail climbs to the summit, and the summit road switchbacks down.

contact_crossing.description: The horizontal granite-limestone contact face at Y=200, exposed inside the service tunnel. The composite terrane plaque is mounted on this face.

schematics: Disneyland Space Mountain.schem (58933 bytes, largest surface build in library)

Cute house.schem (folded into Residential cluster, at the Cute House Plaza)

stations.block: polished_granite with a 1x1 glass_pane window looking at the mountain's exterior

to.description: SE corner of the new city

stage_b_summit_road.cross_section: 4-block polished_granite road + 1-block oak_fence railings on each side. 1 sea_lantern every 8 blocks on 2-block oak_fence posts.

switchback_landings.name: contact_overlook
switchback_landings.note: A 1x1 glass_pane viewing window on the side of the road at the contact-elevation Y=200 contour (the road is at Y=400 here but the overlook looks down at the contact).

switchback_landings.name: landing_5

switchback_landings.name: city_se_corner

composite_terrane_plaque.location: Inside the service tunnel, on the visible horizontal granite-limestone contact face at Y=200. NOT at a ravine bottom (the ravine was dropped in v2.0).
composite_terrane_plaque.dimensions: 2 blocks wide x 1 block tall, mounted flat against the contact face on the west wall of the service tunnel.
composite_terrane_plaque.block_type: polished_granite (matches the granite upper layer) with engraved text via oak_sign overlay
text_lines: Contact age: ~810 million years of erosion before granite emplacement
Discovered in the Cheyenne Mountain Complex drill core, 1966
composite_terrane_plaque.lighting: 1 redstone_lamp above the plaque, toggled by a 1x1 stone_pressure_plate on the service-tunnel floor 1 block in front of the plaque

duplicate_sign_at_summit_road.position: landing_5 of the summit road (0, 200, -180), on the road-side rail
duplicate_sign_at_summit_road.purpose: Lets return-journey visitors see the same contact context from the surface without having to retrace the service tunnel

underground_easter_egg.treatment: Partially buried. Schematic's floor at Y = -3, roof at Y = +2. 1-block-wide entrance at the back of the mushroom-cottage (placed at (-50, 0, 540)) with a 1x1 oak door. 2-3 blocks of dirt and cobblestone above the schematic's roof. 1 chest at the center of the schematic's floor (containing the same written book from the Gateway station, a 'SubTropolis Engineer' name tag, 1 stone pickaxe, 1 stone shovel). 1 redstone lamp toggled by a pressure plate at the entrance. 1 soul lantern at center of ceiling. underground_easter_egg.pre_build_requirement: Schematic must be inspected by a schematic-inspector tool before placement. Confirms footprint (likely 5x5x3) and checks for legacy block IDs. Full 6-marker descent: mkr_new_world_gateway -> mkr_old_town_center -> mkr_grand_avenue_center -> mkr_city_center -> mkr_public_shaft_top -> mkr_subtropolis_chamber_center -> mkr_service_tunnel_contact_crossing -> mkr_cheyenne_outer_portal.

phases.name: New World Prep
phases.goal: Establish the new world's coordinate system, terrain, sky limit, and base infrastructure. The terrain is ONE CONTINUOUS mountain — no ravine, no V-notch. The horizontal granite-limestone contact sits at Y=200.
sub_steps: Create a new default Minecraft world with a deliberate seed (plains biome in SW quadrant for coastal plain, mountains biome in NE quadrant for the single continuous mountain, gradient between them). 1,024+ build height (CubicWorld 2048 recommended). World origin (0, 0, 0). Game mode: creative for build, survival for verification.

Generate the base terrain: coastal plain (600x400 cleared area at (0, 0, 500) flattened to Y=0), ONE CONTINUOUS mountain (600x600 area at (0, 0, -200) with peak at Y=800 and a horizontal contact plane at Y=200 — NO ravine, NO V-notch), new city site (138x138 cleared area at (0, 0, 0) flattened to Y=0). The mountain is intact: limestone from Y=0 to Y=200, granite from Y=200 to Y=800.

Paint the contact: at Y=200, place a 1-block-thick layer of andesite (or a contrasting stone) as the visible contact plane. The contact must be exposed inside the planned service tunnel at (-40, 200, -360). The contact face is the surface where the composite terrane plaque is mounted.
Set the world spawn point to (0, 60, 700) using /setworldspawn.

Install base infrastructure: 1-block-wide dirt path from spawn to old town plaza, 1 chest with 64 oak_planks, 64 stone_bricks, 64 glass_panes (starter kit), 1 sign reading 'YOU ARE IN THE COMBINED COMPLEX - CITY HUB - 0,000 m FROM CITY CENTER'.
Verify: world operational, spawn correct, terrain generated, mountain is one continuous mass (no ravine), sky limit 1024+, world origin (0, 0, 0).

phases.name: Old Town
phases.goal: Place 30-35 schematics (33 total) in 7 clusters in the new world's coastal plain, with historical signs and internal roads.
phases.block_budget_estimate: 15000-20000 blocks (33 schematics at native scale + internal roads + plaza)
sub_steps: Inspect each schematic with a schematic-inspector tool (Python or Node.js script) to confirm footprint, check for legacy block IDs, and identify tile entities. Build the tool if it does not exist (recommended deliverable).

Place Cluster 1 (Residential, 13 builds): start with 2 Cute houses at the plaza center (0, 0, 450), then 10 small houses around the plaza at (0, 0, 480), then victorian palace on a 5-block-tall hill to the north of the plaza.

Place Cluster 2 (Castle/Fortress, 3 builds) on a 10-block-tall artificial hill at (200, 0, 500). Start with md castle 2 on top, then small medieval town hall on south slope, then stone-fortress on east slope. Hill material: cobblestone + mossy_cobblestone.

Place Cluster 3 (Temple, 3 builds) on a mirrored 10-block-tall hill at (-200, 0, 500). Start with japanese-pagoda on top, then red-japanese-temple on south slope, then fantasy-temple-house on west slope. Hill material: spruce_planks + stone_brick.

Place Cluster 4 (Statue/Ornament, 4 builds in cluster) on 1-block stone_brick pedestals in a 4x30 ornamental avenue at (0, 0, 600). Order: stone-statue (south), dragon-egg, giant-skull, snowman (north).
Place Cluster 5 (Theme Park, 1 build): Disneyland Space Mountain at (100, 0, 600) on a 30x30 cleared area with a 3-block oak_plank road connecting it to the Grand Avenue.
Cluster 6 (Underground easter egg) deferred to Phase 6.
Cluster 7 (Cute house anchor) folded into Cluster 1.

Add historical signs: every re-placed schematic gets a 1x1 oak_sign on a fence_post at its entrance or front face. Format: '<SCHEMATIC NAME> - Placed by the mc-fleet-bot fleet, 2026'. The 2 Cute houses get a 2x1 oak_sign founding plaque on a lectern crediting CuteHouse1/2 by name.

Build internal roads: 3-block-wide oak_plank (not stone_brick) roads with 1-block cobblestone edges, connecting the houses to the plaza, the castle cluster to the Grand Avenue, the temple cluster to the Grand Avenue, the statue cluster to the Grand Avenue, and the Space Mountain to the Grand Avenue. Oak-fence lanterns every 8 blocks.

Build the central plaza: 30x30 cleared area at (0, 0, 500), 1-block cobblestone path connecting the 2 Cute houses, 5-block-tall central fountain (hand-built, stone_brick + water). Place a 1x1 glass placeholder for the viewing window (replaced in Phase 6).

phases.name: Gateway Pavilions
phases.goal: Build the 2 matching 7x7 pavilions with obsidian portal frames, /tp command blocks, lectern, bench, and pressure-plate trigger.
phases.block_budget_estimate: 1200-1500 blocks (2 pavilions x 7x7x6 + portal frame + furnishings + paths)
sub_steps: Build the new-world Gateway pavilion at (0, 0, 700) FIRST (in the new world, where the visitor spawns). 7x7 footprint, 6 blocks tall. Stone_brick floor, oak_plank walls (1-block thick) with 2-block glass_pane windows on all 4 faces, light_gray stained_glass roof, 4x5 obsidian frame with glowstone corner notches in the center oriented north-south. Sign above frame: 'YOU ARE IN THE COMBINED COMPLEX - CITY HUB - 0,000 m FROM CITY CENTER'. 1x1 stone_pressure_plate in floor center. Hidden /setblock command_block 1 block north of the frame's inner edge, running 'tp @p 935 60 280', connected to the pressure plate with 1-block redstone_dust. Lectern with written book 'A Visitor's Guide to the Combined Complex' (6-stage inbound journey + credits Lilly/Taylor/Marcus/Hazel as original explorers + updated to describe the funicular+summit-road return route, not a skybridge). Oak_stairs bench on north wall. Minecart on 1-block-gauge rail extending out of south face. 1-block-wide dirt path extending north to the Grand Avenue. 2x1 oak_sign at the entrance. 1 sea_lantern at center of ceiling, 4 glowstone at corners of the obsidian frame.

Build the existing-world Gateway pavilion at (935, 60, 280) in the existing bot world, 3 blocks south of the existing bot base. Same 7x7 cross-section, same dimensions. stone_brick walls (instead of oak_plank), same glass_pane windows, same light_gray stained_glass roof, same 4x5 obsidian frame. Sign above: 'GATEWAY TO THE COMBINED COMPLEX - 0,000 m'. 1x1 stone_pressure_plate in floor center (entering plate). Hidden /setblock command_block running 'tp @p 0 60 700', connected to the pressure plate. Same lectern with the same written book. Same oak_stairs bench. 2x1 oak_sign at the entrance: 'GATEWAY TO THE COMBINED COMPLEX - 0,000 m FROM CITY CENTER - EST. 2026'. Same lighting (sea_lantern + 4 glowstone). 1-block-wide dirt path from the bot base to the pavilion's doorway. Rail terminus at the back (north) of the pavilion with a 'Freight Station' sign and a chest_minecart.

Test the portal transit in both directions. Verify the /tp command block teleports correctly. If a world-portal datapack is available (per the v2.5 polish), use it instead of /tp for the screen-fade effect.

phases.name: Grand Avenue
phases.goal: Build the 425-block stone-brick-to-granite connection from the old town plaza to the SE corner of the new city, with 6 statues, 3 milestones, 1 above-ground stream bridge, and 43 sea-lantern lighting. (The stream is no longer ravine-fed — it is sourced from the limestone hillside at the south face of the mountain.)
phases.block_budget_estimate: 3500-4500 blocks (3400 paved surface + 6 statue pedestals + 3 milestone posts + bridge + lighting)
sub_steps: Lay the roadbed: 4-block-wide x 425-block-long surface from (0, 0, 500) to (60, 0, 70). Blocks 0-350: stone_brick. Blocks 350-425: polished_granite (the material transition at block 350 is a 5-block gradient strip).
Build 2-block-wide x 425-block-long smooth_stone sidewalks on each side, raised 1 block above the road. Total paved surface: 8 x 425 = 3400 blocks.

Place the 6 statues at 70-block intervals on the east sidewalk, each on a 1-block stone_brick pedestal, with a 1x1 oak_sign on a fence_post: teddy-bear at block 70, macaw-statue at block 140, parrot-statue at block 210, flying-eagle at block 280, villager-statue at block 350 (on the material transition), enderman at block 420 (the 'boss').

Place the 3 milestones at the center of the west sidewalk, on 2-block-tall oak_fence posts with 2x1 oak_signs: 'OLD TOWN 1/4 MILE' at block 100, 'OLD TOWN CENTER - CUTE HOUSE PLAZA' at block 250, 'CITY APPROACHING - STREAM CROSSING 100 m' at block 350.

Build the granite-and-glass segment (blocks 350-425): replace stone_brick with polished_granite, add glass_pane inserts every 8 blocks on the sidewalks (matching the new city's skybridge material — note: these glass inserts are NOT the v1.0 skybridge, they are sidewalk-level decorative glass).

Build the stream bridge at block 380: dig a 3-block-wide x 3-block-deep trench for the above-ground coastal-plain stream (sourced from the limestone hillside, NOT from a ravine — there is no ravine in v2.0). Fill the trench with water. Then build a 5-block-wide x 3-block-long x 1-block-tall stone_brick arch over the stream. Add 1-block-tall stone_brick railings on each side, with 1-block gaps.

Install the lighting: 43 sea_lanterns (1 every 10 blocks) on 2-block-tall oak_fence posts at the edge of the road (between the road and the sidewalk). 6 additional sea_lanterns on statue pedestals. 3 additional sea_lanterns on top of milestone posts. Total: 52 sea_lanterns.
Build the connecting dirt path from the Grand Avenue's south end (0, 0, 500) to the old town plaza, 1 block wide, 5 blocks long.

phases.name: Rail Spur
phases.goal: Build the 960-block coastal-plain rail spur (1,030 blocks with pavilion connector) with 3 named stations, powered rails, and redstone wiring.
phases.block_budget_estimate: 3000-4000 blocks (3090 rail cross-section + stations + redstone + paving)
sub_steps: Build the pavilion connector: 200-block east-west rail from the new world Gateway pavilion at (0, 0, 700) to the spur main line at (200, 0, 700). 1-block-wide dirt path alongside.

Build the main line: 630-block north-south rail from (200, 0, 700) to (200, 0, 70). 3-block cross-section: 1-block rail centerline + 1-block oak_plank walkway (east) + 1-block grass/dirt utility strip (west).
Build the old town spur: 200-block west rail from (200, 0, 500) to (0, 0, 500). 1-block-wide oak_plank path connecting the spur to the old town station.

Place the powered rails: 1 powered_rail every 8 blocks on the centerline (1 powered_rail, 7 regular rails, repeat). 1 redstone_torch under each powered_rail (on the utility-strip side). 1 redstone_repeater every 16 blocks. 1 redstone_block at the new world Gateway station as the power source, with redstone_dust running the length of the spur on the utility-strip side.

Build the 3 named stations: (a) New world Gateway station at (0, 0, 700): 7x7 oak_plank platform, sign 'NEW WORLD GATEWAY - Combined Complex Rail Spur', stone_button powered-rail activator, chest with 4 spare minecarts, 'Cities: Old Town Plaza, City Approach' sign, 1-block-wide dirt path to the pavilion. (b) Old town station at (0, 0, 500): 5x7 spruce_plank platform, sign 'OLD TOWN STATION - Cute House Plaza 30 m east', 1-block oak_plank path connecting to the Cute houses. (c) City approach station at (0, 0, 70): 7x7 stone_brick platform, sign 'CITY APPROACH - Grand Avenue 425 m south, City Center 138 m north', 1-block path connecting to the Grand Avenue's north end.

Test the minecart ride in both directions. Verify the cart maintains speed on powered rails, the booster launches it, and stations stop/slow the cart. Test side trips (new world Gateway -> old town spur -> back). Time the full 1,030 blocks (target: 5-7 minutes at full speed).

phases.name: Underground Easter Egg
phases.goal: Place the underground-base.schem at (-50, 0, 550), partially buried, with the historical sign, interior chest, redstone lamp, soul lantern, and glass viewing window.
phases.block_budget_estimate: 200-300 blocks (schematic footprint + burial + interior + viewing window)
sub_steps: Inspect underground-base.schem with the schematic-inspector tool. Confirm footprint (expected 5x5x3), block types, and check for legacy block IDs. If incompatible, fall back to a hand-built 5x5x3 stone_brick room with chest, crafting_table, and redstone_lamp at the same coordinates.
Place the mushroom-cottage at the residential cluster's western edge, at approximately (-50, 0, 540). The cottage's basement will host the easter egg's entrance.

Build the entrance: a 1-block-wide opening at the cottage's basement level, with a 1x1 oak_door. A 2-block-wide x 2-block-tall tunnel from the basement to the underground-base's location at (-50, 0, 550).
Place the underground-base.schem at (-50, 0, 550), with the floor at Y = -3 and the roof at Y = +2. Use WorldEdit //schem load and //schem paste, or equivalent placement tool.

Add the burial: 2-3 blocks of dirt and cobblestone above the schematic's roof. Place a 1x1 oak_sign on a fence_post at the surface: 'THIS STRUCTURE IS THE ONLY EXISTING UNDERGROUND BUILD IN THE WORKSPACE. IT WAS THE SEED OF THE COMBINED COMPLEX. THE SUBTROPOLIS CHAMBER IS ITS DESCENDANT.'

Build the interior: 1 chest at the center of the schematic's floor, containing the same written book from the Gateway station + 1 'SubTropolis Engineer' name_tag + 1 stone_pickaxe + 1 stone_shovel. 1 redstone_lamp at the center of the ceiling, toggled by a 1x1 stone_pressure_plate at the entrance (with 1-block redstone_dust connecting them). 1 soul_lantern at the center of the ceiling for atmospheric lighting.

Build the glass viewing window: replace the 1x1 glass placeholder in the plaza floor at (0, 0, 500) (placed in Phase 2). The glass block is in a corner of the plaza near the Cute houses. Place a 1x1 oak_sign on a fence_post: 'LOOK DOWN - THE FIRST UNDERGROUND BUILD IN THE WORKSPACE LIES BENEATH YOU.'

phases.name: Return Route (Funicular + Summit Road)
phases.goal: v2.0 NEW. Build the funicular rail from the Cheyenne outer portal (0, 200, -420) up 600 blocks to the granite summit station (0, 800, -420), and the switchback summit road descending 800 blocks back to the city SE corner (60, 0, 70). NO skybridge.
phases.block_budget_estimate: 5500-7000 blocks (funicular ~1800 + summit road ~3700 + 8 landings + 1 contact plaque + lighting)
sub_steps: Excavate the funicular shaft: a 3-block-wide x 3-block-deep vertical shaft from (0, 200, -420) to (0, 800, -420) inside the granite peak. The shaft is aligned on the X=0, Z=-420 axis. Use stone (placeholder) and then replace with stone_brick (lower 200 blocks, in limestone) and polished_granite (upper 600 blocks, in granite). NOTE: the funicular shaft is INSIDE the mountain, not exposed to the exterior — this is a tunnel, not a cable car.

Lay the funicular rail: 1-block centerline rail from (0, 200, -420) to (0, 800, -420) — 600 blocks of powered_rail on a 1:1 incline (1 block forward per 1 block up). powered_rail every 4 blocks (not 8 — steeper grade needs more power). 1 redstone_lamp under each powered_rail. 1 redstone_torch every 8 blocks. 1 redstone_block at the summit station as the power source.

Build the funicular walkway: 1-block oak_plank walkway on one side of the rail (visitor can stand and watch the ascent). 1-block glass_pane safety barrier on the other side (no falling off). Total funicular cross-section: 3 blocks wide (rail + walkway + barrier).

Build the 3 funicular stations: (a) Cheyenne outer portal lobby at (0, 200, -420) — 5x5 stone_brick platform with sign 'FUNICULAR TO SUMMIT - 600 m vertical'. Connects to the 25-ton blast door. (b) Optional mid-station at (0, 400, -420) — 3x3 polished_granite platform with a 1x1 glass_pane window looking at the mountain's exterior. Skippable. (c) Granite summit station at (0, 800, -420) — 7x7 polished_granite platform with sign 'SUMMIT STATION - Switchback road to city SE corner 1200 m' and a stone_button powered-rail activator for the descent (if a return minecart is available; otherwise walking).

Build the 8 switchback summit road landings: 4-block-wide polished_granite road between each landing pair. 1-block oak_fence railings on each side of the road. 1 sea_lantern every 8 blocks on 2-block oak_fence posts. Total summit road: 8 named landings (summit_station, landing_1..7, city_se_corner) connected by ~7 road segments. Approximate total length: 1200 blocks (downhill walking).

Mount the composite terrane plaque at the contact overlook: at landing_5 of the summit road (0, 200, -180), place a 2x1 polished_granite sign on the road-side oak_fence rail, reading: 'GRANITE-LIMESTONE CONTACT - Above: 1.08 Ga granite. Below: 270 Ma limestone. Visible in the service tunnel at mkr_service_tunnel_contact_crossing (-40, 200, -360).' This is a duplicate of the in-tunnel plaque so return-journey visitors see the same context from the surface.

Test the funicular ride: spawn a minecart at the summit station, ride down to the Cheyenne lobby (600 blocks, 1:1 decline, powered_rail every 4 blocks, ~3 minutes). Verify the cart maintains speed. Then ride back up to the summit. Then walk the switchback road from summit to city SE corner (~12 minutes, 1200 blocks). Total return: ~15 minutes.
Verify: visitor can complete the return from Cheyenne lobby to city SE corner in ~15 minutes. The 1.6-block enderman at Grand Avenue block 420 still greets them at the city end of the summit road.

phases.name: Service Tunnel + Contact Plaque (In-Mountain)
phases.goal: v2.0 NEW. Excavate the service tunnel from the SubTropolis chamber up to the Cheyenne chamber, expose the horizontal granite-limestone contact at Y=200 inside the tunnel, and mount the composite terrane plaque on the contact face. The plaque is at the contact crossing (-40, 200, -360), NOT at a ravine bottom.
phases.block_budget_estimate: 4500-6000 blocks (120-block service tunnel excavation + 25-ton blast door + contact face exposure + plaque + 1 minecart rail + lighting)
sub_steps: Excavate the service tunnel: a 6-block-wide x 6-block-tall tunnel from the SubTropolis chamber (around 0, -50, -200) to the Cheyenne chamber (around 0, 200, -420). Total length: ~120 blocks. The tunnel climbs from Y=-50 in the limestone to Y=200 at the contact to Y=200+ in the granite. Use the minecart rail method (NOT a skybridge).

Carve the contact face: at (-40, 200, -360), the tunnel wall is the horizontal granite-limestone contact at Y=200. Excavate a 4-block-wide x 2-block-tall viewing alcove on the west wall of the tunnel at this location. The contact face must be visible from the tunnel — do NOT replace the contact with regular stone. Leave the natural andesite (or contrasting) contact plane exposed.

Mount the composite terrane plaque: 2-block-wide x 1-block-tall polished_granite plaque on the west wall of the viewing alcove, centered at (-40, 200, -360). 5 lines of text via oak_sign overlay: (1) 'GRANITE-LIMESTONE CONTACT', (2) 'Above (Y > 200): 1.08 Ga Pikes Peak granite', (3) 'Below (Y < 200): 270 Ma Bethany Falls limestone', (4) 'Contact age: ~810 million years of erosion before granite emplacement', (5) 'Discovered in the Cheyenne Mountain Complex drill core, 1966'.
Light the contact alcove: 1 redstone_lamp on the ceiling of the alcove, toggled by a 1x1 stone_pressure_plate on the tunnel floor 1 block in front of the plaque.
Place mkr_service_tunnel_contact_crossing marker at (-40, 200, -360). Add a 1x1 oak_sign on the tunnel wall: 'mkr_service_tunnel_contact_crossing - The composite terrane plaque is on the west wall.'

Lay the service-tunnel minecart rail: 1-block centerline rail from the SubTropolis chamber end to the Cheyenne chamber end. powered_rail every 8 blocks. 1 redstone_torch under each powered_rail. The rail is one-way (SubTropolis -> Cheyenne); the visitor returns via the funicular, not via this rail.

Install the 25-ton blast door at the Cheyenne end: at (0, 200, -420), build a 5-block-wide x 5-block-tall iron_door assembly (Minecraft iron_door is 1x2; use multiple stacked doors to fill the 5-block height). Sign next to the door: 'CHEYENNE OUTER PORTAL - 25-TON BLAST DOOR'. Hidden /tp command block or funicular entrance is on the other side.

Test the service tunnel transit: ride a minecart from the SubTropolis end (around 0, -50, -200) to the Cheyenne end (around 0, 200, -420) — should take ~5 minutes on powered rails. The cart passes the contact crossing at (-40, 200, -360) — verify the composite terrane plaque is visible from the minecart at full speed, and that the visitor can dismount at the contact crossing to read the plaque.

phases.name: Finishing
phases.goal: Polish, lighting tuning, and verification of the full 60-90 minute visitor journey including the v2.0 funicular+summit-road return.
sub_steps: Verify every re-placed schematic in the old town has its 1x1 oak_sign historical sign. Replace any missing or broken signs.
Verify the 2 Cute houses have their 2x1 oak_sign founding plaque on a lectern crediting CuteHouse1/2.
Verify the 6 Grand Avenue statues have their pedestals and founding-era signs. Verify the 3 milestones have their signs. Verify the 4 glowstone + 1 sea_lantern lighting in each Gateway pavilion.
Verify the v2.0 funicular: 600 blocks of powered_rail on 1:1 incline, 3 stations, 1 glass_pane safety barrier, 1 oak_plank walkway. The funicular rides end-to-end in ~3 minutes.
Verify the v2.0 summit road: 8 named landings, polished_granite surface, oak_fence railings, 1 sea_lantern every 8 blocks. The summit road walks end-to-end in ~12 minutes.

Verify the composite terrane plaque at the service tunnel contact crossing (-40, 200, -360) is visible from the minecart and readable on foot. Verify the duplicate sign at the summit road landing_5 (0, 200, -180).

Tune the lighting: 43 sea_lanterns on the Grand Avenue, 52 sea_lanterns total on the Grand Avenue (including statue pedestals and milestone posts), 100+ sea_lanterns on the summit road, 1 redstone_lamp at the contact alcove, 4 glowstone + 1 sea_lantern in each Gateway pavilion. Verify no dark gaps at night.
Add the 9-bots founding plaque in the old town listing CuteHouse1/2, Builder1/2/5, Packet1/2/3, sloth, badbitch (the 9 historical bots).

Do a timed walkthrough of the full visitor journey (target: 80 minutes, tolerance 60-90). If < 60 min, add more detail. If > 90 min, simplify. Stages: spawn (0) -> old town (10) -> explore old town (15) -> Grand Avenue (10) -> new city (10) -> public shaft (5) -> SubTropolis (15) -> service tunnel + contact crossing (5) -> Cheyenne (10) -> funicular+summit road return (15) = 95 minutes total. If this is too long, the funicular+summit-road return can be shortened to 10 minutes by using minecarts on the summit road.

Do an easter-egg accessibility test: a fresh visitor can find the underground-base by exploring the residential cluster's western edge, or by looking down through the glass viewing window in the plaza.

Capture screenshots of the 6 must-see moments: stepping through the obsidian frame, looking down through the glass window, reading the historical sign, riding the minecart past the Space Mountain, standing between the 2 Cute houses, crossing the stream bridge, AND the v2.0-specific: riding the funicular past the contact elevation, looking at the composite terrane plaque at the service tunnel contact crossing, walking the summit road at the contact overlook.

open_items.topic: v2.0 NEW: Mountain Y=200 contact material
open_items.description: The horizontal contact at Y=200 is painted with a 1-block-thick layer of andesite (or a contrasting stone). The user must confirm: (A) andesite (warm brown), (B) diorite (cool gray), (C) a custom block (e.g., a custom item frame or banner pattern). The contact face must be visible inside the service tunnel at (-40, 200, -360) and at the summit road landing_5 overlook.
open_items.recommended: A (andesite — visually distinct from both limestone and granite, geologically reasonable as a contact metamorphic rock)

total_block_budget_estimate.phase_1_new_world_terrain: 0 (terrain generation, not block placement; +1 layer of andesite at Y=200 = ~360,000 blocks across the mountain footprint, but this is part of terrain generation)
total_block_budget_estimate.phase_3_gateway_pavilions: 1200-1500 blocks (2 x 7x7x6 pavilions + portal frames + furnishings + paths)
total_block_budget_estimate.phase_4_grand_avenue: 3500-4500 blocks (3400 paved surface + 6 statue pedestals + 3 milestone posts + bridge + 52 sea_lanterns)
total_block_budget_estimate.phase_5_rail_spur: 3000-4000 blocks (3090 rail cross-section + 3 stations + redstone + paving)
total_block_budget_estimate.phase_6_underground_easter_egg: 200-300 blocks (schematic footprint + burial + interior + viewing window)
total_block_budget_estimate.phase_7_return_route_v2_0: 5500-7000 blocks (funicular ~1800 + summit road ~3700 + 8 landings + contact plaque + lighting)
total_block_budget_estimate.phase_8_service_tunnel_v2_0: 4500-6000 blocks (120-block service tunnel excavation + 25-ton blast door + contact face exposure + plaque + 1 minecart rail + lighting)
total_block_budget_estimate.total_rough_estimate: 33000-44000 blocks for the map integration alone (excluding the new world's 1,500x1,500 base terrain and the new city / one-continuous-mountain / contact layer specified in the 4 master plans)
total_block_budget_estimate.notes: Rough estimate only. Actual block count depends on schematic footprints (which must be confirmed by the schematic-inspector tool), terrain generation (which is not block-by-block), and decoration density. The 1,500x1,500 new world base terrain is generated by Minecraft's world generator and is not counted as block placement. The Y=200 andesite contact layer is also terrain generation, not block placement. v2.0 adds 10-13K blocks compared to v1.0 (phases 7+8: funicular, summit road, service tunnel, contact plaque).

estimated_build_time.v0_1_MVP: 2-3 days (12 old town schematics, single new-world Gateway, dirt path)
estimated_build_time.v0_5_to_v1_0_full_build: 10-15 days (per working-plan §1.3, the 7 phases sequential, with the v1.0 skybridge return)
estimated_build_time.v2_0_v2_0_full_build_with_no_ravine_and_: 15-20 days (v1.0's 7 phases + the v2.0 service tunnel and return route phases, an additional 5-7 days)
estimated_build_time.v2_5_polish_post_launch: 5-10 days (world-portal datapack, city streetcar, historical plaques, bot-operator missions, guided tour)
